summary: The blind compare flagged nothing: every cloze key and judge verdict matched an independent solve, and no distractor was acceptable. Fixes were an unnatural 用钢琴弹出 sentence, a redundant 嘴里自言自语, a judge item whose clause did not fit 井底之蛙, a near-duplicate of item 052, an odd exam wish in a corrected sentence, and several English cues and one why. Judgement calls left: 马马虎虎 stays mǎ ma hǔ hǔ because the validator's reading table rejects the dictionary hū hū (the guide note says hū hū, so guide and validator disagree); 054/078 both use the frog-in-a-well-who-never-left-town picture but are distinct sentences; 058 keeps 就成了画蛇添足.

chengyu-02-006.note: why wrongly glossed 一丝不苟 as total absorption; now meticulous care.

chengyu-02-014.note: Long two-clause sentence with 闹钟/冲出: level 1 raised to 2.

chengyu-02-040.note: Unnatural 用钢琴弹出一首完整的曲子 rewritten as 自己弹完一首钢琴曲.

chengyu-02-050.note: English 'a spoiling addition' was unidiomatic; rewritten.

chengyu-02-068.note: English: 老板 at a market is the stallholder, not "the owner".

chengyu-02-070.note: Removed redundant 嘴里 before 自言自语 (talking to oneself already implies the mouth); why updated.

chengyu-02-082.note: 店的牌子 is the shop sign, not "brand names"; English fixed.

chengyu-02-086.note: Corrected sentence 祝你万事如意 is an odd exam wish (it is a New Year/general greeting); now 祝你一切顺利.

chengyu-02-088.note: Near-duplicate of 052 (sitting at home waiting for a job); new situation (exam luck), same error.

chengyu-02-095.note: 井底之蛙 means a narrow horizon, not refusing advice; the clause 从来不听别人的意见 did not fit. Rewritten to match the idiom.
